shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

for f in index.html src/*.tsx src/*.ts src/index.css tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; npm -v; node -v
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 peerDependenciesMeta dependencies 2>&1 | head -40
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit@^8.0.0 2>&1 | tail -8 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | sed -n '1,120p'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build build/*/ | head -30; find . -name "*.md" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head; grep -rl "ThemeProvider" build --include=*.d.ts | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls; cat INDEX.md | head -80; ls components | tr '\n' ' '
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls controls guides; cat guides/migration-to-v8.md
grep -n "^#" guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -80; ls components/Select; find . -iname "*input*" -o -iname "*password*" | head
sed -n '39,106p;469,545p;650,752p' guides/migration-to-v8.md
cat components/controls/TextInput.md | sed -n '1,400p' | grep -v '^$' | head -250
grep -v '^$' components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -60; echo ======; grep -v '^$' components/Checkbox.md | grep -E '^\||^#|tsx|<Check' | head -60

grep -n -A40 '^## Providers' guides/theming.md | head -80; echo =====; grep -E '^\| (view|size|type|loading|width|disabled)\b' components/Button.md; grep -n -E '^#|^\|' components/Card.md | head -30; grep -n -E '^\| ' components/Text.md | head -20
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls layout; sed -n '1,200p' layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -vE '^\s*\*|/\*\*' | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout && grep -nE "SpacingValue|SpacingToken|spacing-" types.d.ts | head -20; grep -nE "gap|padding\b|width\b" Box/Box.d.ts types.d.ts | head -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
rm -rf dist && echo 'dist/' >> .gitignore; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -2
npx --no-install vite-node --options.deps.inline=@gravity-ui/uikit /tmp/smoke/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | tail -15

(npx vite --port 5179 --strictPort > /tmp/smoke/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -sf localhost:5179/src/LoginPage.tsx >/dev/null && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:5179/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:5179/src/main.tsx; pkill -f "vite --port 5179"; cat /tmp/smoke/vite.log | tail -5; rm -rf /tmp/smoke; git status --short

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do grep -qa "port.5179" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null && { echo kill ${p#/proc/}; kill ${p#/proc/}; }; done; node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5179/').then(r=>console.log('still up',r.status)).catch(()=>console.log('stopped'))"; git -C /home/sandbox/workspace diff package.json
node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5179/').then(r=>console.log('still up',r.status)).catch(()=>console.log('stopped'))"; git diff package.json
